nodes:
SCOPE:
Read task, devpt reports,
diagnosis plan, AGENTS.md
Identify priority order

TRACE DATA FLOW:
For each fix, map ALL files
in the value chain (batch reads)
Origin → transform → terminator

IMPACT CHECK:
pie_find_impact(name=...)
for every symbol you
plan to edit

PLAN EDITS:
Group by file, find repeated
patterns (batch candidates)
and cross-file patterns

READ source file
(offset/limit targeting
only needed regions)

APPLY ROOT FIX:
Fix the origin of the
data flow first

DEFENSE IN DEPTH:
Add null/uuid fallbacks
at EVERY consumer
in the chain

BATCH SIMPLE PATTERNS:
Use replace_all for renames
Individual edit for multi-line
blocks (batch_edit is brittle)

VALIDATE (batch 3-5 fixes):
Run seed_hypotheses + 
validate_capabilities
Fix regressions immediately

DOCUMENT:
Update status.md
Recent Changes, Known Gaps
bump _Last verified

CHECKLIST:
Tick items in fix plan
(single source of truth)
Delete todowrite

REVIEWER FEEDBACK:
Read code first, verify
claim, fix immediately
Don't argue priority

OPTIMIZE:
Review for double work,
redundant patterns,
missed batch opportunities

GENERALIZE:
Update workflow HTML
Add tool suggestions
found during session
